item.title: Gen X Radio - Town centre has had it tough but there is something
item.description: In his opinion column, David Ellesmere said while it has been tough for Ipswich town centre, there is something for all in the town this Christmas. This article originally appeared on https://www.eadt.co.uk/news/local-council/david-ellesmere-christmas-boost-for-ipswich-8540716

item.title: Gen X Radio - Wigan boss ‘surprised and devastated’ by Cook sacking
